question: ‘The Private life of an Indian Prince’ is a novel written by whom among the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mulk Raj Anand.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘The Private life of an Indian Prince’ is a novel written by **Mulk Raj Anand.**
 
• **He is **known for his** realistic and sympathetic portrayal of the poor in India**.
 
• Awarded by: **Sahitya Akademi Award (1971),** **Padma Bhushan (1967), International Peace Prize(1953).**
 
• His notable works: **Coolie and Untouchable.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Ruskin Bond

 
• **Eminent contemporary Indian** writer of **British descent**.
 
• He **prolifically authored inspiring children's books.**
 
• **He **was awarded the **Sahitya Akademi Award to honor his work of literature.**
 
• The **Room on the Roof** was published in 1956, and it received the** John Llewellyn Rhys Prize in 1957.**

**R K Narayanan**

 
• **Indian writer **known for his work set in the** fictional South Indian town of Malgudi.**
 
• **Awarded by:** **Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Filmfare Award for Best Story.**
 
• One of the three **leading English language Indian fiction writers**, along with **Raja Rao and Mulk Raj Anand.**

**Arvind Adiga **

 
• **Indian writer and journalist.**
 
• His debut novel, **The White Tiger, won the 2008 Man Booker Prize.**
